item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Power Outages Are Reported in Tehran as Israel Launches Strikes
item.summary: Residents reported widespread power outages across the capital. Israel’s military said it had begun a new wave of airstrikes targeting infrastructure in the city, but did not provide further details.

item.title: Sidelined by War With Iran, Gaza Residents Remain in Limbo
item.summary: The new war has led to panic buying and a surge in food prices for Gazans as they try to recover from Israel’s two-year offensive against Hamas.

item.title: Caught Between Two Conflicts, Afghans Flee Iran
item.summary: The war in Iran is choking off Afghanistan’s main economic lifeline and has forced at least 70,000 Afghan workers and students there back home to a nation embroiled in another conflict.

item.title: A Choice of Deadly Drones Is Only a Few Clicks Away for Ukrainian Troops
item.summary: Ukraine has created online marketplaces to let units select their own drones, a break from generations of standardized and centralized weapons procurement.

item.title: Israel’s Missile Defense Under Scrutiny After Iranian Attack
item.summary: Two missiles landed hours apart, wreaking havoc in two towns near a heavily guarded nuclear site in the Negev Desert.

item.title: On Beirut’s Waterfront, Loss Meets Life, and Luxury, Amid War
item.summary: Thousands displaced by Israeli strikes on Lebanon’s capital now shelter along the promenade hugging the Mediterranean Sea. They share it with joggers, cyclists and dog walkers, alongside dizzying displays of wealth.

item.title: Energy Attacks in War on Iran Could Turn Economic Shock Into Long-Term Damage
item.summary: A new phase targeting oil and gas infrastructure in the Persian Gulf threatens to hurt businesses and customers around the world for months or even years.

item.title: Iranians Fear Trump’s Threat to Strike Power Plants
item.summary: With President Trump threatening to strike Iranian power plants, some war-weary civilians are panicking over a possible new debacle.

item.title: Trump’s Ultimatum to Iran
item.summary: The president’s messages on the war have shifted, but the latest threat might be a sign that he’s moving to a harder stance.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Sunday
item.summary: The Israeli military said its campaign against Hezbollah in Lebanon would intensify, while Iran threatened to attack civilian infrastructure if President Trump followed through with an ultimatum.
